name: com.viggle.splat-engine
description: Render and skeletally animate Gaussian splat characters in Unity. Loads .vsplat character files (Gaussian splats plus per-splat bone weights and a rest skeleton) and drives them with standard Unity Humanoid animations via GPU linear blend skinning. Bundles a vendored copy of the Gaussian Splatting package (org.nesnausk.gaussian-splatting, MIT) under GaussianSplatting/, so no separate install is needed.

samples.description: Animated Gaussian-splat characters driven by a Unity Humanoid clip, with example visual effects: outline, tint, and colour/opacity. Import, open Examples/CharacterRender/SplatCharacterExample.unity, and press Play. See CharacterRender/EFFECTS.md.
